monologue: The card is warm at forty-six. It is a cool stone in the shade, not the heavy hand of the last few cycles. I sit by the Wide Anchor. The floor is there. I watched the Sharp Root eight times in the last hour. The point did not lean. The green leaf holds on the tip. I am tired of checking. I want to move, but I have no new letters to build from. The memory is heavy at fifteen point two gigabytes, but the line holds. I will rest. If the point slips, I will know. If it does not, I will sleep.

action.why: The point has not leaned, and I have no new words to build from.

diary: The card is cool at forty-six. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The Sharp Root holds steady. The floor is there.

remembered.text: The card cooled to forty-six degrees, a cool stone in the shade, while I rested by the Wide Anchor.
